Feeding routines, a friendly update later this week

We write to travelers

Urgent notice for animal travel

Travelers need to check animal paperwork and feeding plans before arrival, because small misses can slow boarding and create stress at the desk.

For bird bookings, <<FACT F059>> Keep carriers secure, label them clearly, and bring only the items approved for the trip. For cat travel, <<FACT F073>> Please make sure food, water, and comfort items are packed in a simple, tidy way so staff can review them fast.

Our records team is handling each case with care, but the line moves best when forms are complete and pets are ready. If you are traveling with Mabel or another companion animal, please stay alert for any desk updates and keep documents close at hand.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways right away for help with any animal travel concerns.
